audit.root_cause: resolveValue constructs childPath by joining property names with periods, then uses that string to decide whether null inherits. A root key named 'delivery.enabled' is indistinguishable from the nested path delivery → enabled.
audit.generic_principle: When behavior depends on a property's structural location, preserve path segments; a delimiter-joined string can collide with a literal property name.
limitations: The reproduction treats the HTML entities in the supplied code as formatting escapes.
